basic_info.description: This sunny Mid-Century home is truly move-in ready.     Awash in light from expansive windows and skylights, the home is ideally-configured for entertaining with an open floor plan boasting an expansive combination living/dining area. The adjacent chef's kitchen is appointed with stainless appliances, Caesarstone counters and abundant cabinetry.         The home may be the ultimate in indoor/outdoor living with direct access on this level to a sunny walk-out deck and tranquil garden. The main level is completed by two spacious bedrooms and an attractively-appointed skylit bath.         On the entry level, there is a spacious primary suite which has potential for further expansion.    This lovely home is completed by side-by-side parking for two cars, central air conditioning and abundant storage.
